run_persona_summary_teacher: run the SessionBasePersonaSummaryTeacher to summarize persona lines from MSC dialogue data for a given session
run_msc_dialogue_teacher: run the SessionBaseMscTeacher to generate text in multi-session chat with configurable previous persona context types
run_context_generator: run the ContextGenerator to extract persona strings and dialogue context for bot prompt generation in human evaluation
run_multitask_summary_teacher: run the PersonaSummaryTeacher multi-task teacher across sessions 1-4 for persona summarization training and evaluation
run_msc_multitask_teacher: run the MscTeacher multi-task teacher across sessions 1-5 for multi-session chat dialogue generation
